First, let us load in the data and perform a logistic regression with Lag1 + Lag2 + Lag3. Binomial family used since Direction is a binary outcome.
```{r}
library(ISLR)

glm.fit <- glm(Direction ~ Lag1 + Lag2 + Lag3,
  data = Smarket,
  family = binomial
)

summary(glm.fit)
```

Now, we can make predictions and determine the confusion matrix
```{r}
glm.probs <- predict(glm.fit, type = "response")
glm.pred <- ifelse(glm.probs > 0.5, "Up", "Down")

confusion_matrix <- table(glm.pred, Smarket$Direction)
print(confusion_matrix)
```

And finally calculate classification rate (accuracy)
```{r}
classification_rate <- mean(glm.pred == Smarket$Direction)
print(classification_rate)
```
